field_contracts.route_contracts: routes declare route id, method, path, handler reference, auth requirement, and capability without importing a web framework
field_contracts.session_contracts: sessions are fixture-backed actor and policy envelopes with no credentials or live auth provider
field_contracts.workflow_projection: workflow projection maps workflow stage and artifact refs into product task logs, routes, and artifact downloads without live side effects
field_contracts.task_logs: task logs record status transitions, timestamps, correlation ids, and replay metadata
field_contracts.artifact_downloads: artifact downloads use fixture or artifact URIs plus hashes and never fetch remote objects by default
field_contracts.crud_fixture_state: CRUD fixture state records deterministic create/read/update/delete operations over fixture state keys
field_contracts.db_migration_plan: database migration plans are metadata-only, ordered, and clean-skip without a database client
field_contracts.deployment_targets: deployment targets describe local/container/cloud metadata while live deployment stays disabled
field_contracts.approval_boundaries: approval boundaries gate route mutations, downloads, migrations, and deployments before side effects
field_contracts.clean_skips: clean skips return skipped envelopes for absent framework, database, artifact store, or deployment runtime
